name: The Senpai
source:
A Seinfeld visual novel.

George endeavors to get his senpai to notice him, Jerry tries to help. A childhood friend confesses to Elaine. Kramer makes a remarkable discovery in an abandoned warehouse.
translation:
一款以《宋飞正传》为题材的视觉小说。

乔治努力让前辈注意到自己，杰瑞试着帮忙。一位青梅竹马向伊莱恩告白。克雷默则在一座废弃仓库里有了惊人的发现。
